title: 又 vs 再 in Chinese: Two Ways to Say "Again" (HSK 3 Grammar)
description: 又 (yòu) vs 再 (zài): which "again" to use for the past and the future, word order with 想 and 没有, 别再……了, common mistakes and HSK 3 examples.
h1: 又 vs 再: Two Ways to Say "Again"
lede: Chinese has two words for "again". 又 (yòu) is for something that has already happened again. 再 (zài) is for something that hasn't happened yet: a plan, a request or a suggestion.

paras: Use 又 when the repeat has already happened. The sentence usually ends with 了. It often sounds a little surprised or annoyed, like "not again!" in English. The most common mistake is to use 再 here: 他昨天再来了 is wrong, because yesterday is in the past.

examples.zh: 他昨天来了，今天又来了。
examples.py: Tā zuótiān lái le, jīntiān yòu lái le.
examples.en: He came yesterday, and he came again today.

examples.py: Wǒ de shǒujī yòu huài le.

paras: Use 再 when the repeat is still in the future. You will often hear it in requests and invitations, and with 一遍 or 一次 (one more time).

examples.py: Qǐng nǐ zài shuō yí biàn.

examples.en: You're welcome to come again any time.

examples.py: Wǒmen xià cì zài lái ba.

sections.h2: 又 for things that are sure to happen again
paras: There is one case where 又 talks about the future: something that comes round again for sure, like a day of the week, a holiday or an exam. This 又 usually comes with 是 or 要, and the sentence ends with 了.

examples.py: Xià ge xīngqī yòu yào kǎoshì le.
examples.en: We've got another exam next week.

sections.h2: Word order with 想, 没有 and 别
paras: 又 goes before words like 想, 要 and 没有: 他又没有来 means "he didn't come, again". 再 goes after 想, 要 and 能, directly before the main verb: say 我想再看一遍, not 我再想看一遍.
To tell someone not to do something again, use 别再 + verb + 了.

examples.py: Tā jīntiān yòu méiyǒu lái shàngkè.
examples.en: He didn't come to class again today.

examples.zh: 这个电影很好看，我想再看一遍。
examples.py: Zhège diànyǐng hěn hǎokàn, wǒ xiǎng zài kàn yí biàn.
examples.en: This film is great. I want to watch it again.

worksheet.title: 又 vs 再 Worksheet: HSK 3 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 又 vs 再 worksheet for HSK 3: 20 exercises (choose 又 or 再, word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.instructions: Write 又 or 再 in each gap. The English tells you whether the repeat has already happened.

items.zh: 他上个星期来过，昨天＿＿来了。
items.en: He was here last week, and he came again yesterday.

items.zh: 这个字我没有看清楚，请你＿＿写一遍。
items.en: I couldn't see this character clearly. Please write it again.
Why have you forgotten your phone again?

items.zh: 这个地方很漂亮，我想＿＿来一次。
items.en: This place is beautiful. I'd like to come again.
We've got another holiday next month.

items.zh: 别＿＿喝了，你已经喝了很多了。
items.en: Don't drink any more. You've already had a lot.
He skipped breakfast again today.

items.zh: 我们下次＿＿去那家饭馆吧。
items.en: Let's go to that restaurant again next time.
It's raining again outside.

items.zh: 明天＿＿是星期一了，我不想上班。
items.en: It's Monday again tomorrow. I don't want to go to work.

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence.

items.en: My older brother is ill again.
Please try again.
I'd like to go again.
It's the weekend again tomorrow.
He didn't do his homework again.

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.en: He came again yesterday.
I'll come again tomorrow.
I'd like to have another one.
My computer broke again yesterday.
You're welcome to come again next year.
